summary.name: Fair Value Calculator
summary.one_liner: A web tool that estimates the fair value and quality score of 40,000+ listed stocks worldwide from their reported financials, with an AI chat and an MCP server.
use_cases: Checking whether a stock trades above or below its estimated fair value
Screening 28,000+ stocks by metrics such as P/E, PEG and Piotroski score
Building and monitoring a watchlist of stocks
Comparing a company's quality score across 37 factors
Querying stock valuation data from Claude, ChatGPT or Cursor via MCP
summary.what_it_does: Estimates each stock's intrinsic value from its reported financials by blending 26 independent valuation models, weighted by how much trustworthy data backs each one. It shows a fair value, a separate Quality Score built from 37 factors, and a data coverage measure for each estimate. Users can browse market, region, size and sector views, and a watchlist is included. The Pro tier adds a full screener with 60 metrics and watchlist alerts when a holding flips to Review. The site states that fair value is an analytical estimate, not buy, hold or sell advice.
notable: Blends 26 valuation models into one fair value, weighted by data coverage
Hosted MCP server for use inside Claude, ChatGPT and Cursor
Quality Score from 37 factors kept separate from the valuation
caveats: Full analysis is limited to 8 stocks a month without an account and 13 with a free account
Pro costs $9.90 per month or $99 a year (first month $1) for the full screener and alerts
Not financial advice; fair value is not a buy recommendation
